segments.expected: "That's yours as well." Mara stood up. Her knees had decided, and so she let them. "The wire office at the gate is open all night for the Board. The Reader's at the Library from seven. If I wire her now, she'll have it when she unlocks the door." She took a sheet of the pump house's fault paper from the press, because it was the nearest paper, and sat down again, and wrote. L. ARKWRIGHT, READER, COMPACT LIBRARY, MERIDIAN. THE PAGE IN YOUR PRESS UNDER YOUR WAX OF MONDAY 25TH SIXTH MONTH 2680 IS WANTED BEFORE THE CHARTER BOARD AT SALTMERE ON SUNDAY. TO MY HAND. IF YOU WILL BRING IT YOURSELF I WILL PAY THE TRANSIT. IF YOU WILL BRING ANNICK PERSONAL UNDER YOUR OWN CUSTODY THE BOARD WILL ASK FOR IT. M. ROWAN. She read it over once. Then she took a second sheet and wrote a second.
